items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: at that time, big ol' Louis was the clarinet man in New Orleans

ctx.x: I wondered about the early clarinetists. Did they sometimes play more of the lead or did they always play that part of the chorus?
I'm going to tell you, at that time, big ol' Louis was the clarinet man in New Orleans. Yeah, it was tops. He played the lead because he used the C clarinet, played the violin part.
